title: Trusting Our Father
author: David P. Homer
notes_text: 1.  Louisa Barnes Pratt, in Saints: The Story of the Church of Jesus Christ in the Latter Days , vol. 2, No Unhallowed Hand, 1846–1893 (2020), 103; see also Saints , vol. 1, The Standard of Truth, 1815–1846 (2018), 494–95.

2.  After all, He is our Father. He loves us. And, as Elder Patrick Kearon taught, “[He] is in relentless pursuit of [us]. He ‘wants all of His children to choose to return to Him’ [ General Handbook: Serving in The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints , 1.1 , Gospel Library], and He employs every possible measure to bring [us] back” (“ God’s Intent Is to Bring You Home ,” Liahona , May 2024, 87).
